row.title: Workers Builds is not adopted for deploys; the OIDC path stays the one deploy route
row.body: Reviewed 2026-11-21. Merges to main already deploy the touched Workers within minutes through deploy-ultrastable (OIDC into the site Worker's deploy endpoint, no stored Cloudflare credential), each deploy read back live (live_matches_commit true in ops/deploys.jsonl) with rollback in the handoff closer. Workers Builds would add a second deploy per merge from a separate build with no read-back or rollback record, race the first for the same Worker version, and needs a Cloudflare to GitHub consent in the dashboard before it can run. Its preview URLs for branches are the one gain; they are not worth a second production route. Default in effect: one deploy route; revisit when previews are wanted by a measured need.
